confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee/beer anchors use October 2026 Reykjavik price data, translated approximately to USD. Cocktail (~1.6 times draft beer) and wine (~1.2 times draft beer) reflect local bar-price relationships. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates with substantial seasonal uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Reykjavik prices are based on local reports; accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of Nordic capital and high-tourism lodging costs.
